This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their pointed brows, head stripes, and [[Color|green]] [[hair]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Alderaan-Diplomats.png|thumb|right|200px|A pair of diplomats belonging to this species]]
In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> during the height of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s reign, a family of three members of this species was present at a party for [[Politics|dignitaries]] held by the [[House of Organa]] on the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species made the [[Part I|first episode]] of the [[2022]] televisions series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />
